name: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting
definition: A method that constructs a 3D language field using 3D Gaussians to enable precise and efficient open-vocabulary querying, addressing the imprecise boundaries and slow rendering of NeRF-based methods like LERF.
summary: 3D Language Gaussian Splatting constructs a 3D language field using 3D Gaussians to enable precise, efficient open-vocabulary querying in 3D spaces.
